subject.title: fix(agents): use per-attempt replay metadata for silent provider-error retry gating (#97877)

question: Should this PR add `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` as the attempt-result signal and retry classified empty `server_error` turns before assistant failover?
rationale: The code path fixes a real bug, but the choice affects harness compatibility, provider failure routing, session state, and message delivery; those are maintainer-owned semantics rather than a purely mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Require full-runner proof then consider merge
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway or full-runner output showing `[empty-error-retry]`, one recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or message side effects before accepting the new semantics.

options.title: Accept extracted proof and own the risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the current predicate-level proof and focused tests if they consider the runtime risk low enough.

options.title: Pick another canonical branch
options.body: If a competing same-root PR is preferred, pause or close this PR after preserving any useful tests or proof there.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof then consider merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway or full-runner output showing `[empty-error-retry]`, one recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or message side effects before accepting the new semantics.
